text_blocks.snippet: The January 6 investigation refers to the probe into the attack on the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021. A House Select Committee was formed to investigate the events, focusing on the causes and circumstances surrounding the attack, including the role of various individuals and groups, as well as the effectiveness of government responses.
